Keywords: rest api endpoint express route handler request response validation
Prompt Template: Create a [METHOD] /[path] endpoint that [action]. Input: [schema]. Output: [schema]. Error cases: [list]. Include: input validation, error handling, async/await, JSDoc.
Output: Fully functional Express route handler with validation and error handling
Best Practices: Specify the exact request body schema. List all error cases. Mention auth requirements (middleware). Include example request/response in prompt.
Example: Create a POST /api/users endpoint that creates a new user. Input: {name: string, email: string, password: string}. Validate email format, hash password with bcrypt, check for duplicate email. Return 201 with user object (no password), or 400/409 on errors.

Keywords: react component typescript props state hooks functional component ui
Prompt Template: Create a [ComponentName] component in TypeScript. Props: [interface]. State: [what it manages]. Behavior: [interactions]. Style: [Tailwind/CSS modules/styled]. Include: prop types, loading/error states, accessibility.
Output: Typed React component with full prop interface and state management
Best Practices: Define the Props interface clearly. Specify all UI states (loading, empty, error, populated). Mention accessibility requirements (ARIA). Reference the design system being used.
Example: Create a UserCard component in TypeScript. Props: {user: {id, name, email, avatar?}, onSelect: (id: string) => void, isSelected: boolean}. Show avatar with fallback initials. Highlight when selected. Include focus ring for keyboard navigation. Use Tailwind.

Keywords: sql database schema table design relationships indexes foreign keys normalization
Prompt Template: Design a PostgreSQL schema for [domain]. Entities: [list]. Relationships: [describe]. Requirements: [query patterns]. Include: proper types, constraints, indexes for common queries, timestamps.
Output: SQL CREATE TABLE statements with indexes and constraints
Best Practices: List the main query patterns you need to optimize for (this drives index design). Specify cardinality of relationships. Mention if soft-deletes are needed (adds deleted_at). State your scale expectations.
Example: Design a PostgreSQL schema for an e-commerce order system. Entities: users
column10: order_items. Users can have many orders. Orders have many items (with quantity and price at time of order). Need to query orders by user and date range frequently. Include soft deletes on products.

Keywords: python data processing pandas script file transform csv json api batch
Prompt Template: Write a Python script that [reads/processes/transforms] [data source]. Input: [format/schema]. Output: [format/schema]. Handle: [edge cases]. Use: [libraries]. Include: error logging, progress reporting.
Output: Complete Python script with error handling and logging
Best Practices: Specify input/output formats exactly. List edge cases (empty files, malformed data, encoding issues). Mention performance needs (batch size for large files). Specify libraries already in use.
Example: Write a Python script that reads a CSV of customers (columns: id, name, email, created_date), filters for customers created in the last 90 days, enriches with subscription status from our API (GET /users/{id}/subscription), and outputs a JSON file. Handle API rate limits (100 req/min) and missing subscription data.

Keywords: authentication auth jwt session login logout register security password hash
Prompt Template: Implement [auth type: JWT/session] authentication for [framework]. Features: register, login, logout, [refresh/protected routes]. Security: [password hashing, rate limiting, HTTPS-only cookies]. Include: middleware for protected routes.
Output: Complete auth system with security best practices
Best Practices: Specify JWT vs session (different implementation). Mention token storage approach (httpOnly cookie vs localStorage — use cookie). Include refresh token strategy for JWT. State which database/ORM is in use.
Example: Implement JWT authentication for an Express/TypeScript API. Features: register (bcrypt password), login (return access_token + refresh_token in httpOnly cookies), logout (clear cookies + blacklist token), /me endpoint (protected). Use Prisma for DB. Rate limit login to 5 attempts/15min.

Keywords: unit test jest vitest testing suite mock spy describe test expect coverage
Prompt Template: Write unit tests for [function/module name]. Test: [list behaviors to test]. Mock: [external dependencies]. Coverage: happy path, edge cases, error cases. Framework: [Jest/Vitest].
Output: Complete test suite with mocks and all test cases
Best Practices: List every behavior to test explicitly. List every external dependency to mock. Specify if you need setup/teardown. Mention code coverage target.
Example: Write Jest unit tests for the UserService class (file: src/services/UserService.ts). Test: createUser (success, duplicate email, invalid email), getUserById (found, not found), deleteUser (success, not found, already deleted). Mock: Prisma client, bcrypt, email service. Aim for 90%+ coverage.
